subject: Budget range validation: DataCorp monthly token volumes & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@datacorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: budget range validation and next steps

Thanks for taking the time today Alex — great conversation. Quick recap and the asks to keep momentum:

Summary
- DataCorp use case: customer-facing summarization + personalization for help center (primary RUs = text generation + embeddings for search).
- Expected peak patterns: bursts around product releases, steady baseline traffic.

What I need to validate this week
1) Approx monthly token volume (your range worked example): low / mid / high (tokens/month)
2) Target unit economics: target $ per 1M tokens (or target monthly spend) that would get leadership/procurement comfortable
3) Procurement thresholds: any internal approval bands (eg. >$X needs PO/Legal)

From our call I heard:
- rough expected volume: ~150M–250M tokens/month
- target budget: somewhere in the low-to-mid $100k/month range if we can hit committed pricing

I've attached a pricing breakdown (Redwood-pricing-1M-token-breakdown.xlsx) with a few example unit economics: pay-as-you-go, 3mo committed, 12mo committed tiers. Also included a draft mutual action plan (Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf).

Next steps
- Can you confirm the volume band you expect (best guess for month-1 and month-3)?
- If you have a target $/1M tokens or a monthly budget band, that helps us size an internal pricing flex/discount.
- If procurement has threshold levels, please flag them and loop in the appropriate stakeholder.

Thanks — I’ll loop Aditya from Rev Ops if we have procurement questions to speed contracting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget range validation and next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the docs. Quick answers from our side: 

- Volume estimate: realistic steady state ~200M tokens/mo, with spikes to ~400M in big weeks. For pilot month we’d expect ~50–75M while we validate.
- Target unit economics: leadership is looking for ~$1,800 per 1M tokens (that’s the internal target we’re using to model spend).
- Procurement thresholds: anything over $250k/month requires procurement + legal review; finance needs a PO for multi-month commitments.

A few questions:
1) Does Redwood offer an additional committed-discount layer at 12mo beyond the 12mo tier in the sheet?
2) For reserved/dedicated capacity, can we get a deterministic per-token rate for forecasting?

Looping Emily (procurement) so she can confirm approval bands and required docs.

Hi Alex / Emily — thanks for the details. Short answers and a clearer cost table attached.

1) Committed discounts: yes — beyond the standard 12mo public tier we can provide an additional committed discount band for customers committing to sustained volume (we call this Reserved Capacity pricing). I've added a column in the attached spreadsheet (Redwood-pricing-1M-token-breakdown.xlsx) showing the effect:
- PAYG: $2,500 / 1M tokens (example for gen-heavy workload)
- 3mo commit: $2,100 / 1M
- 12mo commit: $1,600 / 1M
- Reserved capacity (12mo + capacity commit + SLA): possible down to $1,200 / 1M depending on burst profile and KV cache reuse

2) Dedicated / reserved: yes — we provide deterministic throughput and a quoted per-token unit used for forecasting. If you want a firm number for modeling, we can propose a committed quote based on your expected 200M tokens/mo baseline.

3) Procurement thresholds: noted — $250k/month triggers procurement + legal review. For forecasts where you land between $100k–$250k/month, we can typically proceed with standard SOW + PO and our standard terms; >$250k will require additional legal review and may take longer.

Attached: updated pricing workbook and a short note on forecasting assumptions. Also adding our HubSpot deal link for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DC-2026-045

If you can confirm the month-1 pilot (50–75M) and a month-3 expected baseline (best guess), I’ll put together a committed quote and an internal pricing approval request.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Redwood-pricing-1M-token-breakdown.xlsx (updated)
From: Emily Park <emily.park@datacorp.com>

Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 15:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget range validation and next steps

Thanks Marissa — procurement side here. Confirming our thresholds: 
- <$50k/month: finance approval only
- $50k–$250k/month: procurement + PO required (standard review)
- >$250k/month: procurement + legal + exec sign-off (longer timelines)

For any committed quote that would push us over $250k/month we will require:
- Master Services Agreement or SOW (legal)
- Standard insurance certs and SOC2 attestation (if not already provided)
- PO process and expected payment terms (Net30/Net45 negotiable)

Please send a draft SOW and a committed quote for the 200M tokens/mo baseline (and an optional tier showing reserved capacity at $1,200 / 1M). We will route the docs for legal review once we have the SOW/quote.
